# Frozen benchmark packages

These are immutable compatibility inputs, not outputs regenerated by tests.
The archives contain complete 33 x 33 H6 packages (PNG8, float32 TIFF,
configuration, manifest and CSV references).

| Archive | Historical producer commit | Coverage | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| benchmark-v1.zip | 7069e7b3fa7a462d8889a49a6447fe91375ef1e1 | Static, two frames | 262397deadd4cb8fe3528ffde084f5df335da9f5639983d85e4ac8591194423d |
| benchmark-v2.zip | f9d736e1abf47625447d4aeccbe81919a18c0151 | Energy scan, common drift, dense/sparse schedules, five frames | 5ef1b63494d93428ed796eb6cefb88679ac85ff23d4682209090f04223e415f5 |

Captured once on 2026-10-06 from byte-exact source snapshots of the commits
above, with Python 3.12.3, NumPy 2.2.5, Pillow 11.2.1 and tifffile 2025.3.30.
The snapshots had no Git metadata, so their manifests correctly record null
Git revision/dirty values; the original source hashes and library versions
remain inside each manifest. The archives' fixed ZIP timestamps are packaging
metadata, not acquisition times.

Do not overwrite these files or update their pinned test digests when changing
the generator. Add a separately named fixture for a new format version.
Tests extract copies to temporary directories and call the current public
reader. Missing, changed or unreadable historical packages must fail validation.


`benchmark-v3.zip` was captured before stage 04 changes on 2026-10-07 from
generator sources at `b12cc932109d77562fe2eb098e84b3c95e43fb6a`. The checkout
also contained unrelated user changes, so its recorded Git dirty flag is true.
It contains two 33 x 33 H54 energy observations, elliptical profiles and 216
independent masks. SHA-256:
`21ff2bc6daf5c54f0188cfa649d508329fe70307dcf209207ff5fa0b6fc551c5`.
This additional archive does not replace or regenerate the v1/v2 fixtures.
